          type: string

          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and name). Optional; when supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address' input, normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations) and used to compose the returned 'address'. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form: a non-blank addressLine1, or the flat address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "Optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Normalized to E.164 form on input (a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped); stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-() +0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must fall on a business day; if the effective date (supplied or defaulted) is a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the next Monday, and that adjusted date is stored and used for all derived values.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner can be created even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household); the owner is then a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. The shared householdId is derived automatically from the last name and postcode. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied; a request without a postcode is still accepted."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it (relative to the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

              example: "DR Who"

              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: "LON-SMI-0007"
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.

              example: "LON-SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true

              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned identifier shared by every owner with the same last name and postcode (one household).               type: string
              example: "A1B2C3D4E5F6"
              readOnly: true

Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches; because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different identityKeys (they surface instead as a soft match). Derived deterministically, so it is stable across requests."
              type: string

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true

              title: Timezone

              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true

              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
